title: Value Set file
description: Value Set definitions and slot bindings (spec section 7). Any YAML file in profiles/vocab/ may hold value_sets, bindings, or both. Value Set ids are unique across all files. See profiles/README.md.

version.description: Definition version (vocabularies.version). Increment on every change.

mode.description: enumerated: a small ordered list of terms. rule: membership resolved in QLever from the rule.

terms.description: Ordered terms (position = list order). Required for enumerated sets; for rule sets it is the optional pinned shortlist.

label.description: Curated label (vocabulary_terms.label_override). When absent the label comes from entity_labels.

is_default.description: Preselected for new entries. Defaults to false.

deprecated.description: Hidden from pickers for new values; still displayed where present. Defaults to false.

unique.description: Identifier type whose values are unique per record (e.g. accession number); cleared when a record is cloned.

Rule.description: Membership rule for mode: rule. All four keys are present (use [] for none); at least one of metatype_uris, broader_roots, classes is non-empty.

metatype_uris.description: Concepts whose classified_as includes any of these metatypes are members.

broader_roots.description: Concepts reachable through broader+ from any of these roots are members.

classes.description: Restrict members to these concept classes.

Binding.description: Binds a Value Set to the URI values found at (class, path).

enforcement.description: Overrides the Value Set's enforcement for this binding. Absent = inherit.

Enforcement.description: strict: violation (blocks publish). extensible: warning. advisory: info.

Uri.description: Absolute http(s) URI. Prefixed names such as aat:300404670 are not accepted.

LangMap.description: Human-readable string keyed by BCP-47 language tag in canonical case (language lower, Script title, REGION upper). 'en' is required. Values must contain a non-space character.

Path.description: Profile path: dot-separated Linked Art JSON-LD keys, each optionally filtered by class, e.g. identified_by[Name] or produced_by.timespan. Grammar in profiles/README.md.

RecordClass.description: A top-level Linked Art record class (linked.art docs/ns/v1/record-types.json).
